fixed.explanation: The embedded-control branch only handles role 'textbox', so input type=search (role 'searchbox') contributes nothing. Adding 'searchbox' to the textbox condition makes it return its value the same way.

query.intent: Accessible name computation (roleUtils getElementAccessibleName / getTextAlternativeInternal) handles embedded controls inside a label or aria-labelledby target. Textbox and input embedded controls contribute their value, but searchbox role (input type=search) is not included in the embedded-control branch.
query.symptom: An input type=search embedded in a label or aria-labelledby target contributes nothing to the computed accessible name, unlike text inputs.

history.analysis: The embedded-control branch only handles role 'textbox', so input type=search (role 'searchbox') contributes nothing. Adding 'searchbox' to the textbox condition makes it return its value the same way.
